children: EHang Holdings Ltd. Sponsored ADR Class A (NASDAQ:EH) posted Q2 2026 revenue of RMB77.9M with 36 eVTOLs delivered and 520 GD4.0 drones, a strong QoQ rebound despite a net loss, while pilotless EH216-S demos in Hong Kong and international partnerships and programs push overseas commercialization and large-scale drone shows.
: EHang (EH) Q2 2026: revenue RMB77.9M (US$11.5M), up 203.5% QoQ, down 31.3% YoY. Delivered 36 eVTOLs, 520 GD4.0 drones. Gross margin 61.2%. Net loss RMB128.3M (US$18.9M).

: EH's EH216-S pilotless eVTOL completed public demo flights at Hong Kong Cyberport Aug 28–30, performing VTOL, low-altitude cruise and hover on preprogrammed routes to validate reliability and safety.
Overseas Push Via Sandbox, Global Fast Track
: EHang (EH) expanded overseas push via regulatory sandbox participation and a Global Fast Track program to speed international market entry and commercialization.
: EHang Holdings Ltd. (EH) partners with TryHard and SKYTEK to develop large-scale drone light shows in Japan, leveraging EHang’s drone tech for music events, tourism and brand promotions.
